entries.name: Re-run: 200 items detect a 5-point gap in ~22% of comparisons
entries.summary: An independent re-implementation (new script and seed) of one cell of the paired-bootstrap power simulation: 200 binary items, ~70% base accuracy, a true 5-point gap and shared-difficulty mixing rho 0.5 — the 95% CI excludes zero in 22.5% of 1000 comparisons (SE 1.3 pp), median half-width 7.75 points.

entries.name: Simulated: 100-200 item benchmarks rarely resolve a 5-point gap
entries.summary: Monte Carlo simulation, binary-scored items at about 70% accuracy, item-level correlation between arms about 0.25-0.64: a paired bootstrap 95% CI detects a true 5-point gap in only 13-19% of 100-item comparisons and 20-34% of 200-item ones; at 500 items detection rises to 51-76%. At that gap the median CI half-width is 8.0-10.5 pp at n=100, 5.8-7.8 pp at n=200 and 3.6-4.8 pp at n=500 (pooled over gaps 0-10: 7.5-11.0, 5.3-7.8, 3.4-4.9).

conditions.analysis: paired bootstrap 95% CI on the accuracy difference
conditions.task: comparing two systems or prompts on one shared benchmark

packages.name: Paired-bootstrap power on small benchmarks: study + re-run
packages.summary: The simulation finding on how rarely 100-200 item binary benchmarks resolve a 5-point gap, together with an independent re-implementation of its n=200 cell, the re-run script and its output.
